_comment: Micro-dares in front of the table. Hard content rule: nothing dangerous, nothing involving drinking, nothing that humiliates anybody and nothing that depends on having a particular body. 'nivel' is only a hint of how silly it gets, from 1 to 3.

desafios.texto: Talk for thirty seconds without saying 'yes' or 'no'.
Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, it doesn't count.
Impersonate somebody at the table until they guess who.
Say the alphabet backwards in under twenty seconds.
Talk like a news presenter for fifteen seconds.
Describe your day yesterday as an opera.
Go ten seconds without blinking.
Smile without showing your teeth for fifteen seconds while everyone stares.
Count to twenty in the language you know least. Making half of it up is allowed.
Be a statue for twenty seconds. If you laugh, you lose.
Explain how to make an omelette as if it were a nature documentary.
Do three animal noises and get the table to guess at least two.
Speak in rhyme for thirty seconds. Bad rhymes accepted.
Make up a tongue twister on the spot and say it.
Do the worst foreign accent you can for fifteen seconds.
Tell a true story about yourself in under twenty seconds.
Genuinely compliment the person on your right.
Talk about yourself in the third person until your turn ends.
Explain a famous film as if it were the most boring thing ever made.
Advertise an object in the room as if it were on a shopping channel.
Say five words that rhyme with 'blue' without repeating.
Interview somebody at the table with two questions, as a football pundit.
Whisper with the energy of a shout for fifteen seconds.
Recite the months of the year in alphabetical order.
Tell a children's story as a horror story in twenty seconds.
Talk like a robot until your turn ends.
Name seven car brands without repeating and without pausing more than three seconds.
Describe your home to someone who has never seen a house.
Put on a cartoon voice and introduce everyone at the table one by one.
Count from one to ten skipping multiples of three, and say 'boom' on each skip.
Impersonate a celebrity without saying their name. Get them to guess.
Explain the rules of this game in under fifteen seconds.
Take a dramatic pause and then say something extremely deep that means nothing.
Talk without using the letter 'e' for fifteen seconds.
Talk without using the letter 'a' for fifteen seconds.
Give an award acceptance speech for something absurd.
Commentate on what everyone else is doing as if it were live sport.
Name three things you genuinely admire about someone at the table.
Recite a TV advert you know by heart.
Show how you would walk a hundred kilos heavier, then a hundred lighter, without standing up.
Make the strangest face you can and hold it for ten seconds.
Explain a sport with your hands only, no words, until they guess it.
Name everyone at the table, in order, from memory, with your back turned.
Talk as if you had just run a marathon for fifteen seconds.
Invent a fake news headline about the person on your left. Keep it kind.
Hum a song until somebody guesses it.
Count to twenty without saying any numbers: use gestures.
Say thank you in five different languages.
Be a tour guide for the room you are in.
Speak in a made-up language for fifteen seconds, with total conviction.
Explain what the internet is to somebody from 1850.
Hold eye contact with somebody for fifteen seconds without laughing.
Recite the planets of the solar system in order.
Put on a cartoon accent and read out loud whatever is on somebody else's screen.
Describe somebody at the table with three adjectives and get the rest to guess who.
Make the sound of a musical instrument until they guess it.
Share a completely harmless secret nobody here knows about you.
Impersonate the worst singer at the table. Affectionately.
Give an improvised thirty-second toast.
Name five blue things you can see right now.
Say two sentences backwards, word by word.
Explain your job or your studies as the most exciting thing in the world.
Sing happy birthday as heavy metal.
Do a five-second dance demonstration, sitting down.
Name seven countries each starting with a different letter.
Summarise your favourite film using exactly five words.
Ask somebody at the table for something with the most exaggerated politeness imaginable.
Spell your full name backwards.
Commentate on your own life for fifteen seconds.
Recite a shopping list of ten items and get somebody to repeat it all.
